item.title: Answering questions about Zerodha’s approach to F&O and MTF
item.description: This discussion on Tradingqna started with a question about retail participation in derivatives, why F&O volumes are falling, and how we are thinking about business diversification. This then became a philosophical discussion about why we offer F&O and MTF, and whether we are compromising on our values by offering products like MTF. These are questions I get asked often: “You keep speaking about the philosophies of Zerodha, how you guys give back, etc.
